facts: Convolutional neural networks are computationally expensive.
Convolutional neural networks must examine all image locations.
Stochastic attention-based models have been shown to improve computational efficiency at test time.
Stochastic attention-based models remain difficult to train.
Stochastic attention-based models are difficult to train because of intractable posterior inference.
Stochastic attention-based models are difficult to train because of high variance in the stochastic gradient estimates.
Techniques from the literature on training deep generative models are borrowed.
The Wake-Sleep Recurrent Attention Model is presented.
The Wake-Sleep Recurrent Attention Model is a method for training stochastic attention networks.
The Wake-Sleep Recurrent Attention Model improves posterior inference.
The Wake-Sleep Recurrent Attention Model reduces the variability in the stochastic gradients.
The Wake-Sleep Recurrent Attention Model can greatly speed up the training time for stochastic attention networks.
The Wake-Sleep Recurrent Attention Model can greatly speed up the training time for stochastic attention networks in the domain of image classification.
The Wake-Sleep Recurrent Attention Model can greatly speed up the training time for stochastic attention networks in the domain of caption generation.
